scope: User-requested comprehensive retrospective review of all eight candidate factors. F01-F07 completed screens including fresh F05 diagnostics; F08 execution status only. No new training, environment rollout, predictor fitting, hyperparameter search, or changes to frozen implementations.
status: Post-hoc audit and synthesis after earlier reports and F05 summary have been read. This is neither preregistration nor independent scientific confirmation.
planned_review_calculations: Recompute every stored model prediction MAE, allocation choice, selected O40, weighted aggregation, and common-baseline consistency from frozen branch features and predictions. Do not refit models.

For the listed original primary and secondary contrasts, show both same- and cross-repeat increments, all three original-seed blocks and four context groups, all changed choices, and baseline top-two predicted margin. Do not replace original primary contrasts with favorable auxiliary results.

Audit concentration by reporting changed-choice counts, gains and losses, and the descriptive effect of omitting the single largest positive contribution without renormalizing. This is not a new selection rule or a confidence interval.

Recompute current-episode return-to-success calibration Brier comparisons across all 21 task/held-seed cells. Distinguish contemporaneous encoding from predicting future improvements and choosing an allocation.
Summarize all 768 model-task rollout errors, finite-rollout sampling SE, no-tail differences and tail magnitudes; do not treat tail bootstrap as exact ground truth.

Verify all F05 completion references, preserved-model flags, raw diagnostic episode/MC CSV hashes, trace-verification receipts, and actual measurement/verification costs. Reuse original full-trace verification; do not claim to have re-executed 10.752M simulator steps.
Reconcile F07 pair reversals and reliability rule summaries; keep its subsampling scheme separate from other primary contrasts.
Report common-baseline outcome and original-policy losses by context. Hindsight best is only a biased descriptive reference; no adaptive stopping or policy switch is evaluated here.
limitations: Most labels are the same historical 180 branches and 148800 evaluation rows: 12 starting states, 9 pretraining histories, 3 original seed blocks. D50/O50 and leave-original-seed-out fitting do not make repeated research on these data independent confirmation. No leave-composition-out confirmation, common 4k packet, causal replay manipulation, new original seeds, or equal-total-budget online comparison is performed.
decision_rule: Preserve prior frozen screening rules (at least1pp primary gain, at least2 positive original seed blocks, no context group below-2pp). Keep measured phenomena, useful predictors, operational policies, and causal explanations separate. Mechanistic explanations and proposed future tests are hypotheses, not newly authorized experiments.
cost: Only offline CPU/file review; new environment steps0, persistent learner updates0, cloned learner updates0. Timestamped immutable outputs and code/input hashes; preserve failed attempts.
